title: The Word of Life, Walking in the Light

questions.question: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we looked upon and have touched with our hands, concerning the ____ of life—
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:1 (ESV): "That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we looked upon and have touched with our hands, concerning the word of life—"

questions.question: the life was made manifest, and we have seen it, and testify to it and proclaim to you the ____ life, which was with the Father and was made manifest to us—
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:2 (ESV): "the life was made manifest, and we have seen it, and testify to it and proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and was made manifest to us—"

questions.question: that which we have seen and heard we proclaim also to you, so that you too may have ____ with us; and indeed our ____ is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:3 (ESV): "that which we have seen and heard we proclaim also to you, so that you too may have fellowship with us; and indeed our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ."

questions.question: And we are writing these things so that our ____ may be complete.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:4 (ESV): "And we are writing these things so that our joy may be complete."

questions.question: This is the message we have heard from him and proclaim to you, that God is ____, and in him is no darkness at all.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:5 (ESV): "This is the message we have heard from him and proclaim to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all."

questions.question: If we say we have fellowship with him while we walk in ____, we lie and do not practice the truth.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:6 (ESV): "If we say we have fellowship with him while we walk in darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth."

questions.question: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the ____ of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:7 (ESV): "But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin."

questions.question: If we say we have no ____, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:8 (ESV): "If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us."

questions.question: If we ____ our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:9 (ESV): "If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness."

questions.question: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to ____ us our sins...
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:9 (ESV): "If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness."

questions.question: and to ____ us from all unrighteousness.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:9 (ESV): "If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness."

questions.question: If we say we have not ____, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:10 (ESV): "If we say we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us."

questions.question: Who is the author of 1 John?
questions.explanation: While the author is not explicitly named in the text, early church tradition and internal evidence strongly point to John the Apostle, the son of Zebedee and author of the Gospel of John.

questions.question: According to verse 5, God is ____ and in him is no ____ at all.
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:5 (ESV): "This is the message we have heard from him and proclaim to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all."

questions.question: What cleanses us from all sin according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: 1 John 1:7 (ESV): "But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin."

key_verse_text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
